nodes.description: Public payable mint guarded by nonReentrant; requires exact price, validates tokenId range, checks ownership in the external N contract, stores a generated N and safe-mints.
Private view pseudo-random operator selector using block.timestamp, block.difficulty, msg.sender.balance and tokenId; applies unchecked arithmetic.
Private generator that chains eight external InterfaceN getter calls through random() and writes lastGenN.
Builds on-chain SVG/JSON metadata using toString and Base64.encode.
Internal pure uint256 to decimal string conversion using loops and division by ten.
onlyOwner withdrawal that transfers the whole ETH balance to the owner.
onlyOwner withdrawal that queries and transfers the full balance of an arbitrary ERC20 token.
Private receiver check that performs an external onERC721Received callback and an assembly revert on failure.
Internal safe mint that mints and then validates the receiver callback.
Internal mint that writes _balances and _owners after zero-address and duplicate checks.
Internal transfer that clears approvals and updates balances and ownership.
Public transfer authorized through _isApprovedOrOwner(_msgSender(), tokenId).
Public four-argument safe transfer that authorizes the caller then performs a callback-checked transfer.
Public approval that requires the caller to be owner or approved-for-all before writing _tokenApprovals.
Public operator approval keyed by _msgSender().
Internal view authorization helper combining owner, approval and operator checks.
onlyOwner ownership transfer that rejects the zero address and calls _setOwner.
Override that chains ERC721 and ERC721Enumerable bookkeeping.
Interface identifier dispatcher chaining ERC721 and ERC721Enumerable.
onlyOwner function that sets the owner to the zero address.
Private ownership setter that writes _owner and emits OwnershipTransferred.
Public view returning the stored _owner.
Address of the external InterfaceN contract used for ownership and seed queries.
Last generated N value, mutated by nGameFromSeed and used as the seed for the next generation.
Mapping from tokenId to the generated N value.
Fixed mint price of 0.015 ether.
Mapping from owner address to token balance.
Mapping from tokenId to owner address.
Mapping from tokenId to approved spender.
Mapping owner to operator to approval boolean.
Reentrancy lock state toggled by the nonReentrant modifier.
Stored contract owner address.
Array holding every token id for enumeration.
Caller address used for authorization checks and as randomness entropy.
Block timestamp consumed inside random() as randomness entropy.
Unchecked addition, subtraction, multiplication and division applied to generated N values inside random().
External call to the user-supplied addressN contract's ownerOf during mint.
Eight external view calls to InterfaceN getters (getFirst..getEight) inside nGameFromSeed.
External callback to IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received triggered during safe mints and transfers.
payable(owner()).transfer(address(this).balance) executed in withdrawEth.
External balanceOf/transfer calls on an arbitrary ERC20 token contract in withdrawErc20.
keccak256 over block.timestamp, block.difficulty, msg.sender.balance and tokenId produces miner/caller-influenceable randomness.
Inline assembly extcodesize check inside Address.isContract.
Inline assembly base64 encoder inside Base64.encode.
Token id supplied by the caller to mint, range-checked and used for the external ownership check.
Token id passed to nGameFromSeed, forwarded to the external InterfaceN getters.
Running generated value fed into random as the left operand.
External N-derived number used as the right operand of the random operation.
Token id mixed into the randomness hash inside random.
Local accumulator initialised from lastGenN and repeatedly updated by random().
Local modulo-four result of the randomness hash that selects the arithmetic operation.
Token id whose metadata is being rendered.
Local string holding the encoded metadata payload.
Arbitrary ERC20 token address whose full balance is withdrawn.
Local balance of the token held by the contract before transfer.
Address the token is transferred from.
Address the token is transferred to.
Token id being transferred.

Unsigned integer converted to its decimal string representation.

edges.reason: tokenId parameter flows into the mint body where it is range-checked and used.
tokenId is passed to the external InterfaceN.ownerOf ownership check.
mint performs an external call to InterfaceN.ownerOf on the user-controlled addressN contract.
mint calls nGameFromSeed to derive the generated N stored in userGeneratedN.
nGameFromSeed invokes random eight times, each performing unchecked arithmetic.
nGameFromSeed issues eight external calls to the InterfaceN getters.
tokenId parameter is forwarded to every external InterfaceN getter call.
Values returned by the external getters feed the arithmetic in random.
The currentGenN accumulator is passed as the left operand into random.
random derives the opNum local from the entropy hash.
random executes unchecked addition, subtraction, multiplication or division.
The weak keccak256 randomness result drives random's arithmetic selection.
block.timestamp is used as entropy for the pseudo-random generation.
msg.sender.balance is used as entropy for the pseudo-random generation and is caller-influenceable.
mint uses _msgSender() for the ownership requirement and as the mint recipient and seed input.
_msgSender() is forwarded as the operator argument to the receiver callback.
mint calls _safeMint, which triggers an external receiver callback inside the nonReentrant window.
_safeMint first calls _mint to perform the state updates.
_safeMint then calls _checkOnERC721Received, which performs the external callback.
_checkOnERC721Received invokes IERC721Receiver.onERC721Received on the recipient contract.
A malicious receiver can re-enter mint during the callback; the nonReentrant guard is the only mitigation.
safeTransferFrom ends in a receiver callback through _checkOnERC721Received.
The _data parameter is carried by safeTransferFrom down to the receiver callback.
_mint increments the recipient entry in _balances.
_mint writes the new owner into _owners.
_transfer decrements and increments _balances entries.
transferFrom relies on _isApprovedOrOwner for authorization.
transferFrom authorizes using _msgSender() as the spender.
transferFrom delegates the actual movement to _transfer.
safeTransferFrom authorizes using _msgSender() as the spender.
approve requires _msgSender() to be the owner or an approved operator.
The local owner address is compared against _msgSender() in approve.
approve writes the spender into _tokenApprovals.
setApprovalForAll keys the operator approval on _msgSender().
setApprovalForAll writes into _operatorApprovals.
withdrawEth is protected by onlyOwner, which compares owner() with _msgSender().
withdrawEth reads owner() for both the onlyOwner check and the transfer recipient.
withdrawEth performs a native transfer of the contract balance to the owner.
withdrawErc20 is protected by onlyOwner, which compares owner() with _msgSender().
withdrawErc20 performs external calls on an arbitrary, possibly malicious ERC20 token.
The _token parameter selects the external contract that is called.
The measured local balance is the amount passed to the external transfer.
transferOwnership is protected by onlyOwner, which compares owner() with _msgSender().
The newOwner parameter is validated and forwarded to _setOwner.
transferOwnership delegates the ownership write to _setOwner.
owner() returns the stored _owner value.
_setOwner writes the new value into _owner.
The price state variable is compared against msg.value inside mint.
mint updates the userGeneratedN mapping with the generated N.
nGameFromSeed writes the new generated value into lastGenN.
The addressN state variable is the target of the external ownership call made during mint.
The tokenId parameter selects which token's metadata is rendered.
tokenURI calls toString to render the generated value.
The output local variable holds and returns the assembled metadata string.
The value parameter is consumed by the toString conversion loops.
tokenURI reads the stored generated N from userGeneratedN.
Base64.encode processes the metadata bytes produced inside tokenURI.
The assembly extcodesize check decides whether the receiver callback is attempted.

normalization_plan.reason: The tokenId parameter only exists to drive the mint function's checks and external call; it can be normalised into the mint node.
The tokenId parameter is only used to look up the external N getters from inside nGameFromSeed.
The running generated value is an operand internal to the random operator selector.
The external N-derived number is an operand consumed exclusively by random.
The token id is only mixed into random's entropy hash.
The accumulator local is declared and updated purely within nGameFromSeed.
opNum is a local selector computed and consumed inside random.
The token id parameter is only required by the tokenURI rendering path.
The output local holds and returns the assembled metadata string of tokenURI.
The token address parameter only selects the external contract in withdrawErc20.
The measured balance local is directly consumed as the amount argument of the external ERC20 transfer.
The from address parameter is only forwarded through the transferFrom transfer path.
The to address parameter is only forwarded through the transferFrom transfer path.
The token id parameter drives the authorization and transfer inside transferFrom.
The newOwner parameter is validated and written only through transferOwnership.
The value parameter is the sole input of the toString conversion.
The _data parameter is forwarded by safeTransferFrom into the receiver callback.
The cached owner local is read only inside the approve authorization checks.
